Senior Odoo Developer – Bucharest 
 New Peaks helps companies redesign and digitize how they work, using ERP solutions with Odoo at the core. We’re looking for a Senior Odoo Developer to join our team in our Bucharest office and own the technical side of our implementations. You’ll shape solution design with our functional consultants, build what standard Odoo can’t cover, and help raise the technical bar across the team.
 What we offer: 
Technical ownership: you have a real say in architecture, standards and how we build
Varied implementation projects across distribution, manufacturing, retail, services and e-commerce
A small, senior team where you work side by side with consultants and meet clients directly
Company-supported Odoo certifications and training
Room to grow into a technical lead role
Competitive compensation based on experience
 What you’ll do: 
Design and build custom Odoo modules (Python, ORM, OWL, QWeb, XML) that are clean, upgrade-safe and maintainable
Translate business requirements into technical solutions, and challenge them when standard functionality or configuration does the job better
Design and build integrations with external systems (REST APIs, XML-RPC/JSON-RPC, webhooks, EDI, e-commerce platforms, banking and ANAF services)
Lead data migrations and version upgrades of custom code
Set technical standards: code reviews, testing, Git workflow and deployment on Odoo.sh
Take part in client workshops when technical input is needed
Mentor junior and remote developers
 What we’re looking for: 
5+ years of Python development, including at least 3 years building on Odoo
Deep knowledge of the Odoo framework: ORM, inheritance, security model, OWL, reporting
Strong PostgreSQL/SQL, JavaScript and HTML/CSS skills
Experience with Odoo.sh or Linux deployments and Git-based workflows
Solid understanding of business processes (sales, purchasing, inventory, manufacturing, accounting)
Clear communication with non-technical stakeholders; Romanian and English
Based in Bucharest (or willing to relocate) and working from our office
 Nice to have: 
 Odoo certification, OCA contributions 
Docker, CI/CD, automated testing
Romanian localization experience (e-Factura, SAF-T/D406, ANAF integrations)
 Interested? Apply here on LinkedIn or send your CV to jobs@newpeaks.eu.
 A GitHub profile or a short note on a project you’re proud of is a big plus.
